editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: IC Markets is a legit, ASIC/CySEC-regulated ECN broker with 18 years of operation and raw spreads that genuinely compete at the institutional tier. The cTrader Raw Spread account at $7 all-in per lot on EUR/USD is best-in-class pricing in 2026, and same-day withdrawal processing holds up under public scrutiny — 4.8/5 on Trustpilot from 53,000+ reviews with 91% five-star ratings is not something you fake at that volume. The class action filed against the AU entity in February 2024 is a material concern that deserves monitoring, but it does not indicate fraud and has not resulted in any regulatory enforcement. Most global clients land on offshore entities with zero compensation protection — understand which entity holds your funds before you deposit. A top-tier execution broker for traders who know what they are doing and have at least $200 to start.
